immutable_raw_inputs_note: Metrics recomputed from frozen pilot_results.json rows only; no scenario rerun.

variant_denominators.display_note_wrong_interval: Stress identifier wrong_interval: generative truth remains inside the stated boundary box (narrower truth-containing interval); not a misspecified empty set.

per_variant.display_note_wrong_interval: Stress identifier wrong_interval: generative truth remains inside the stated boundary box (narrower truth-containing interval); not a misspecified empty set.

totals.feasibility_note: LP feasibility / optimal bounded point estimates do not imply the generative truth witness lies in the stated identification polytope; feasible alternative trajectories may exclude the true state trajectory.

bounded_deployable.note: Conditional on bounded_status optimal and primal violation <= 1e-5.

masked_mean.note: Conditional on bounded_status optimal and primal violation <= 1e-5.

forward_fill.note: Conditional on bounded_status optimal and primal violation <= 1e-5.

interval_midpoint.note: Conditional on bounded_status optimal and primal violation <= 1e-5.

oracle_diagnostic.note: Conditional on bounded_status optimal and primal violation <= 1e-5.

uncertainty_bootstrap.estimand: Pooled arithmetic mean of metric over all stress×seed cells in each bootstrap resample; clusters are independent seeds; all valid cells per drawn seed are kept and multiplicity when a seed is redrawn is preserved.
uncertainty_bootstrap.limitations: Ten seed-level clusters only; inference is conditional on bounded optimal cells; not cell-level Bayesian inference. Prior analysis used 10 iterations and dropped multiplicity via set membership (post-hoc correction, not frozen at preregistration).

od_nnls_benchmark_status.erratum: Frozen v4 runner uses nan_to_num(count_bounds, 0) center and fits OD NNLS on all incidence rows ignoring count_observed_mask (experiments.py ~L114–115). Do not use od_nnls_total_error for comparative claims; future fix: A[mask], c[mask].

partial_identification_coverage_note: Coverage columns use distinct eligibility: unconditional matrix rows with boolean field, conditional on bounded point valid, or conditional on joint_within_assumption. LP infeasible rows omit lp_data coverage booleans.

accuracy_finding.summary: On shared-valid cells (n=81), masked-mean missing RMSE is lower than deployable bounded missing RMSE; bounded does not beat simple imputation baselines on this metric. No state-of-the-art or superiority claim is supported.
accuracy_finding.consistency_only_evidence: Interval tightening / tube coverage statistics are descriptive of stated assumptions; see reconciliation.totals coverage blocks with explicit denominators.

matrix_summary.paired_comparison_note: Conditional means use identical seeds where bounded_status is optimal and primal violation <= 1e-5; failures are excluded, not imputed.
